name: OpenHands
shortDescription: Open-source AI software engineering agent platform that executes code, runs terminal commands, and edits repositories autonomously.
description: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin) is an open-source AI platform for autonomous software development. Operating inside secure Docker container sandboxes, OpenHands enables AI agents to edit code, execute shell commands, run tests, browse web documentation, and interact with GitHub repositories to perform complex software engineering tasks.

pricing.details: Free and open-source software under the MIT license; OpenHands Cloud offers hosted agent infrastructure and enterprise management tier.

features: Secure Docker-sandboxed execution environment for isolated code modification and bash execution
Autonomous software engineering agents capable of reproducing bugs, running unit tests, and creating pull requests
Web UI and CLI interfaces for interacting with agent workflows and inspecting execution logs
Multi-LLM integration supporting Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Ollama local models, and custom endpoints
useCases: Automating routine code bug fixes and GitHub issue resolution in open-source and private codebases
Refactoring legacy codebases and generating unit test suites autonomously
Benchmarking autonomous AI developer performance on benchmark suites like SWE-bench
limitations: Requires Docker installed for local runtime sandboxing and bash execution
Complex multi-step agent tasks require API keys for high-capability frontier models

seo.title: OpenHands — Open-Source AI Software Engineering Agent
seo.description: Discover OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin), the open-source AI platform for autonomous software engineering, Docker sandbox execution, and repo editing.
